caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair placed against a plain, light beige background. The chair has a black frame with vertical slats on the backrest and armrests extending horizontally from each side. The seat is made of interwoven straw or cane material, colored in light brown or tan. The rocking legs are curved and match the black color of the chair’s frame. The drawing is simple with no additional objects or decorations, and the artist's signature “Aime Colman” appears in the lower right corner.
title: Rocking Chair
